title: Rust Adoption Grows in Operating System Kernels
summary: Memory safe drivers land in mainline releases this year.

body.text: Supporters point to similar efforts abroad that delivered results within a few years.
Officials stressed that the plan will be rolled out gradually to avoid disruption.
The hard part was never the technology, it was the coordination.
The team behind the effort credits a small group of volunteers who worked through the summer.
Critics argue the numbers are promising but still need to be confirmed at larger scale.

author.name: Tom Okafor
author.bio: Developer tools and open source reporter.
